text:
The repair of the Tamsin Reservoir spillway cost 12 million in total, according to the Tamsin Basin Water Authority's Annual Infrastructure Expenditure Report, presented at a public board meeting on 21 March 2024.

The figure is 1.5 million below the original estimate. The work replaced 340 meters of cracked spillway lining.

The report states that the final invoice was approved on 14 March 2024. Dr. Halvard Quillon, the Authority's chief engineer, signed off on the repair costs.

The report does not attribute the saving to a single cause, and this newspaper has not seen the contractor's invoice itself. The figures given here are those published in the Authority's document.

The board received the report at its open session on 21 March, one week after the invoice was approved.
